author: hide1
description:
MOSS-Image catalog data
	

34,395 character samples + 314 styles = 34,709 generated images, plus a 280-pixel thumbnail for each. Eight mutually exclusive style categories. Uncurated; no pass/fail labels. These are synthetic samples, not AnimaDex/Krea2 reference artwork. Not a validated character-recognition benchmark or an assertion of model training coverage.
Open the catalog · Project, generation settings and sample workflows
